That's the good. The bad? Sutton still hasn't surpassed 60 receiving yards in a game this season. The touchdown helps, but one productive fantasy performance doesn't erase eight weeks of limited production.

He is not expected to be a worthwhile asset moving forward, though he could see more work if Ladd McConkey (back) has to miss time.
